title: UPL Ct4 cotton (96 16): Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: UPL Ct4 cotton: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: UPL Ct4 cotton is a cotton variety from IPB UPLB. See its days to harvest, yield, pest ratings, traits and where it grows best.
excerpt: UPL Ct4 is a registered cotton variety, also sold or known as 96 16. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council (NSIC) in 1994 as NSIC 1994 Ct 06. IPB UPLB bred it. It takes about 106 days from sowing to harvest, with 2.19 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: Key facts about UPL Ct4 cotton
How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

UPL Ct4 cotton takes about 106 days from sowing to harvest. That is 13.5 days faster than the average of the 7 cotton varieties with a day count, 119.5 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 2.19 t/ha matches the average of its group, 2.15. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.

blocks.text: The pests and diseases that hit cotton fields most often: [eggplant leafhopper](/pests/eggplant-leafhopper), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm), [Fusarium wilt](/diseases/fusarium-wilt). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Where and when to plant UPL Ct4 cotton
Cotton needs a long dry spell at boll opening. Pick a variety by lint yield and fiber quality. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Pagtatanim ng puno](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-puno).

items.q: Is 96 16 the same as UPL Ct4?
items.a: Yes. 96 16 is another name for UPL Ct4, registered as NSIC 1994 Ct 06. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes about 106 days from sowing to harvest. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 2.19 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of UPL Ct4?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
